Ostrzeżenia

Pominięte
Ograniczenia
  • Static heuristic scan, not a runtime trace or proof of scene reachability.
  • Manifest and auto bundles do not count as consumer usage.
  • Configuration strings and text mentions are not proof of rendering.
  • Variable keys, concatenation and templates can hide use; review dynamic calls before deleting anything.
  • Comments are ignored in supported syntax. This is not a full JS/TS parser; regex literals and complex templates may need manual review.
  • Tools, tests, docs, vendor, build folders, backup folders and large source files are excluded.
  • Fonts, atlas images and data files may be used indirectly through CSS or other assets. No automatic deletion is offered.
